AUTHOR: Jelea, A; Belbachir, AN; Leordeanu, M
TITLE: Closer to Ground Truth: Realistic Shape and Appearance Labeled Data Generation for Unsupervised Underwater Image Segmentation
DATA: DeepFish (segmentation subset); DeepSalmon (own, control/ozone tank videos)
V_EV: Sec. 2: 'Most of the fish in our dataset are hard to detect, even by human eye, due to the poor visibility'
D_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'the 2 datasets have a train-validation-test split of 80% - 10% - 10% for both DeepFish and DeepSalmon' (unit not stated)
R_EV: Sec. 4.2/Table 1: each dataset trained and tested on its own split; 'results ... on DeepFish and DeepSalmon, 2 dataset with different fish and habitat appearance'
E_EV: Table 1: 'Metric scores for the two stages of our approach ... Dice ... IoU' (segmentation metrics only)
ARCH: SegFormer-b4; synthetic fish copy-paste with TPS warping and histogram matching (unsupervised two-stage)
NOTE: Coded as ECCV 2024 Workshops paper from arXiv text. Inclusion rests on DeepFish (field dataset); DeepSalmon is aquaculture tank footage. 80/10/10 split is NOT the DeepFish predefined 50/20/30; unit not stated -> D1 NR. Only internal thresholds (0.8 confidence for histogram pixel sampling; pseudo-labels at best-Dice PR point) used in training, no output threshold -> C NR. NIMG = 620 DeepFish seg + 200 DeepSalmon annotated frames. DeepSalmon 12 videos at 25 fps; availability not stated.
